spans.s:
घ्न घ्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. हन्, and used at
the end of compounds to express) killing, striking,
a killer, destructive, destroying, removing; see अर्थ-
घ्न, ज्वर-घ्न, शत्रु-घ्न, गो-घ्न, दण्ड-
घ्न; (also to express) multiplied by; see द्वि-
चतुर्-घ्न. In a few compounds the fem. may
end in आ [cf. कुल-घ्ना]; (अम्), n. killing, de-
struction.

घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत् (pres. part.), striking, beating,
hurting, killing.
